steps.text: Start with one 15-oz can of pumpkin and add two eggs.
Mix the pumpkin and eggs until it is nice and fluffy.
Add 1/2 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp of cinnamon, and 1/4 cup packed brown sugar.
Measure about a teaspoon (maybe two) of vanilla and add it, then mix.
Add 1/4 cup of oil (lard was used), 2 1/2 cups of flour, and 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Mix the batter until combined without overmixing.
Put some butter on the pan and cook the pancakes like you would any other pancake.
Serve classic with butter and maple syrup or with chocolate chips and homemade Cool Whip or chocolate syrup.
